name: Tulsi (Holy Basil)
shortDescription: A sacred plant in Hinduism, known for its medicinal properties.
description: Tulsi, also known as Holy Basil, is a aromatic perennial plant native to the Indian subcontinent. It is widely used in Ayurvedic medicine and is considered a sacred plant in Hinduism.
medicinalUses: Boosts immunity and helps with cold

name: Ashwagandha
shortDescription: An ancient medicinal herb used in Ayurvedic medicine.
description: Ashwagandha is an evergreen shrub that grows in India, the Middle East, and parts of Africa. Its roots and orange-red fruit have been used for hundreds of years for medicinal purposes.

name: Neem
shortDescription: A versatile medicinal plant used in various AYUSH systems.
description: Neem is a tree native to India, known for its pesticide and medicinal properties. All parts of the neem tree are used for various medicinal purposes.

name: Turmeric
shortDescription: A powerful anti-inflammatory and antioxidant spice.
description: Turmeric is a flowering plant of the ginger family, commonly used as a spice in cooking and for its medicinal properties.

name: Senna
shortDescription: A natural laxative used in Unani medicine used to treat constipation
description: Senna is a large genus of flowering plants in the legume family. Its leaves and fruit are used for their laxative properties.

name: Nilavembu
shortDescription: A bitter herb known for its potent antiviral and immune-boosting properties.
description: Nilavembu, also known as Andrographis paniculata, is widely used in the Siddha system to treat fever, infections, and to enhance overall immunity.

name: Arnica
shortDescription: A homeopathic remedy used primarily for pain and injury.
description: Arnica is a herb widely utilized in homeopathy for its ability to treat pain, bruising, and trauma. It is known for speeding up the healing process of injuries.

name: Aloe Vera
shortDescription: A soothing and healing plant widely used for skin health and digestion.
description: Aloe Vera is a succulent plant known for its therapeutic properties, particularly in soothing skin conditions and promoting digestive health. It is commonly used in Yoga and Naturopathy to support internal cleansing and skin care.

name: Amla
shortDescription: A potent source of Vitamin C with numerous health benefits.
description: Amla, also known as Indian Gooseberry, is a fruit used in traditional medicine for its high vitamin C content and antioxidant properties. It is commonly used in Ayurveda and Naturopathy to boost immunity, enhance digestion, and promote overall health.

name: Izkhir (Lemon grass)
shortDescription: A cooling and calming herb used for its aromatic and therapeutic properties.
description: Izkhir, also known as Vetiver, is a grass with a rich, earthy fragrance. It is widely used in Siddha and Naturopathy systems for its cooling effects on the body, stress relief, and its ability to promote calmness and relaxation.

name: Gajar (Carrot)
shortDescription: A nutrient-rich root vegetable known for its benefits to eye health and digestion.
description: Gajar, commonly known as Carrot, is a root vegetable rich in beta-carotene, vitamins, and fiber. It is used in Naturopathy and dietary practices to support eye health, improve digestion, and boost immunity.

name: Badiyan (Saunf)
shortDescription: A flavorful spice with digestive and respiratory benefits.
description: Badiyan, also known as Saunf or Fennel, is a spice with a sweet, aromatic flavor. It is widely used in Ayurveda and Naturopathy to aid digestion, relieve bloating, and support respiratory health.

name: Kabasura Kudineer
shortDescription: A herbal formulation known for its antiviral and immune-boosting properties.
description: Kabasura Kudineer is a traditional Siddha herbal formulation composed of multiple herbs, primarily used to boost immunity and fight respiratory infections. It is widely recognized for its effectiveness in treating flu-like symptoms and supporting respiratory health.

name: Amukkara Choornam
shortDescription: An adaptogenic herbal powder that helps reduce stress and improve vitality.
description: Amukkara Choornam is a well-known Siddha medicine made from the root of Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera). It is commonly used to enhance strength, reduce stress, and improve overall vitality and well-being.

name: Maharasanadi Kwatham
shortDescription: A classical formulation for joint pain and inflammatory conditions.
description: Maharasanadi Kwatham is a traditional Ayurvedic formulation used primarily for the treatment of joint pain, arthritis, and other inflammatory conditions. It is composed of various herbs that help reduce inflammation, improve mobility, and relieve pain.

name: Yogaraj Guggulu
shortDescription: An  formula used for joint and muscle health, particularly in relieving arthritis and rheumatism.
description: Yogaraj Guggulu is a classical Ayurvedic formulation that combines Guggulu resin with various herbs to support joint health and reduce inflammation. It is primarily used to treat arthritis, muscle stiffness, and other inflammatory conditions related to the musculoskeletal system.
medicinalUses: Aids in the treatment of arthritis and rheumatism

name: Brahmi Vati
shortDescription: An herbal tablet known for enhancing memory and cognitive function.
description: Brahmi Vati is a traditional Ayurvedic formulation made primarily from Brahmi (Bacopa monnieri), known for its ability to enhance memory, focus, and cognitive function. It is widely used to manage stress, anxiety, and mental fatigue, promoting overall brain health.

name: Triphala Churna
shortDescription: A traditional powder known for its detoxifying and digestive benefits.
description: Triphala Churna is a famous Ayurvedic formulation consisting of three fruits: Amla, Haritaki, and Bibhitaki. It is renowned for its gentle detoxifying properties, promoting digestion, and supporting overall gastrointestinal health.
